name: Sakanakura Yumi
source:
Another strange member of class 2-B.
She's a (almost never present, even a ghost-like) member of the school's Drama club. Yumi has the atmosphere and the looks of a mature woman. She is also very picky about the people she socializes with. She can even be violent if she dislikes the person she is taking with.
